item.title: TraceAnything
item.description:
The Problem
Videos are typically processed as sequences of independent frames or as static 3D reconstructions, which loses temporal continuity. Tracking arbitrary points across a video—whether for editing, 3D reconstruction, or scene understanding—requires either expensive per-frame correspondence matching or specialized trackers that don't generalize well. item.title: zero agent

item.title: FlashDB
item.description:
The Problem
Redis's single-threaded event loop caps throughput on modern multi-core hardware. Scaling Redis requires clustering, which adds operational complexity and network overhead. FlashDB targets that bottleneck with a multi-threaded, lock-free design that speaks the RESP protocol, so existing Redis clients work without modification.
What This Does
